# Beta Gadgets Setup & Support Basics

## First-time setup

Every Beta Gadget pairs over Bluetooth using the companion app; hold the
side button for 5 seconds until the LED pulses blue to enter pairing mode.

## Firmware updates

Firmware updates push automatically through the companion app once a
gadget is paired; a gadget more than 2 major firmware versions behind
should be manually updated before any other troubleshooting, since many
reported bugs are already fixed in the current firmware.

## Battery life expectations

A fully charged Beta Gadget lasts approximately 18 hours of continuous use;
a device dying in under 4 hours after a full charge indicates a battery
health issue eligible for the product/defect process, not a usage question.
